_comment: The CLI surface the stage table reads, and nothing else. Measured, not guessed.
'regulative_rules' is EMPTY, and that is a measurement rather than an omission.
sg-childcare-leave.l4 carries exactly one regulative rule -- the CDCSA s 12B(8)
obligation to grant and to take the leave before the relevant period ends. With
a single rule in the module, `l4 export --to bpmn` EMITS THE BPMN instead of
refusing with the list of rule names that discover.mjs's `rules` probe reads, so
the probe reports BROKEN on a module that is in fact fine. Pinning the empty
list records what the probe can establish today; the rule's own name is in the
'checkers_that_must_exist' is empty because this subject declares no leg that
shells out to a checker: p7-lts, p7-mcp, p7-wizard and p7-akn are all internal
to the l4 CLI. Adding a DMN or BPMN leg would add the corresponding validators.
